text: NEMA14 RP2040 | USB-C PD & Logic Power
A4 landscape  |  1 / 4  |  Named nets connect across sheets  |  NC = intentionally unused pin

U_PD / CH224K requests 15 V (CFG1=0, CFG2=CFG3=1).
Open-drain PG is active low. DP/DM short: PD-only mode.
R_PD + C_PD supply/filter the negotiation IC.
Schottky diodes accept either supply and block crossfeed.

U_BUCK / AP63203 converts LOGIC_IN to 3.3 V.
4.7 uH L_BUCK and output capacitors filter the switching node.
C_BOOTSTRAP supports the high-side gate driver.
A4 landscape  |  2 / 4  |  Named nets connect across sheets  |  NC = intentionally unused pin

U_MCU / RP2040 generates STEP/DIR and reads power status.
Internal regulator: 1.1 V core. Flash/clock/bypass: next sheet.
U_ESD / USBLC6 protects D+/D-. R_CC1/2 identify a USB sink.

Q_DATA / MMBT3904 senses host 5 V without a direct GPIO feed.
DATA_PRESENT LOW means host attached.

R_RUN holds reset high; SWD / RUN pads allow debug.
USB ROM boot: BOOT pads on next sheet.
NEMA14 RP2040 | Flash, Clock & MCU Supply
A4 landscape  |  3 / 4  |  Named nets connect across sheets  |  NC = intentionally unused pin

U_FLASH / GD25Q16 provides 2 MB firmware storage.
RP2040 has no internal flash. BOOT shorts QSPI_SS via R_BOOT
to ground during reset, entering the ROM USB bootloader.

Y_MCU / ABM8 is the USB clock reference.
Load capacitors support oscillation; R_XOUT limits crystal drive.

Each capacitor is a distinct fitted part.
IO pin numbers appear in references.
VREG_OUT feeds V1V1; no external 1.1 V source.

6.2k / 1k VREF and 0.24 ohm shunts: 0.239 A nominal.
ENABLE pull-up / SLEEP pull-down keep the driver off.

U_DRV regulates both windings at fixed 1/16 microsteps.
C_CP / C_VCP / C_VREG support the internal driver rails.
Bulk capacitance and TVS limit transients; regeneration needs bench tests.

Passive 100k / (10k || 470R) divider: VM / 223.77.
Input stays below 0.3 V even when MCU power is absent.
